title: v0.8.0 live shakedown + progress/dry-run/report/readability
desiredOutcome: The orchestrator is proven by a real end-to-end run, and a long phase is legible (progress output), previewable (dry-run), and reportable (richer report).
summary: First real /audit:phase run (throwaway Nx monorepo, git in test/, nothing pushed) proved preflight/gitRoot/lock/branch/parallel-subagents/commit-hygiene/sign-off/ff-merge live, and found the gate-cd bug (fixed). Then added progress output, --dry-run, a richer report, and a readability pass. 196 selftest cases.

tasks.title: Live end-to-end shakedown + gate-cd fix
tasks.description: First real run surfaced that 0.7.0's 'run gates from gitRoot' broke 0.2.0 manifests whose buildCommands carry 'cd <gitRoot> &&'. Fix: git via git -C <gitRoot>; gates run from the project dir verbatim; init prefixes cd for subdir workspaces. Also: no-result subagent = explicit failure/retry.

add: shakedown run restored the repo 1:1; commit hygiene held with gitRoot strip

outcome.technical: Validated against a live repo (test-mono-expo, git in test/); nothing pushed; full restore verified.
outcome.descriptive: The orchestrator now has a real end-to-end run behind it, not just unit tests.

tasks.title: Progress output + --dry-run
tasks.description: Emit per-step progress during a phase; add --dry-run preview (read-only plan, no mutation) to next/run/phase.

outcome.technical: Progress output + Dry-run sections in orchestrator.md; verbs branch on --dry-run.
outcome.descriptive: A long phase is now legible and previewable.

tasks.title: Richer report + readability pass
tasks.description: render-report: overall header, per-phase branch/mergedAt, task outcome column (16 selftest cases). README TL;DR, orchestrator At-a-glance, scannable status markers.

add: 16 render-report selftest cases incl. overall header + outcome + phase meta

outcome.technical: All self-contained + escaped; status shows [x]/[~]/[!]/[ ] markers + overall line.
outcome.descriptive: Status and report read at a glance.
